name: Two Pointers
description: Two pointers involve iterating through a data structure with two references that move toward each other or in the same direction. This reduces time complexity from O(N^2) to O(N) for many sorted-array problems.
how_to_identify: Sorted array, pair-sum problems, or problems about partitions where a brute-force nested loop feels too slow.
use_cases: Two Sum II - Input Array Is Sorted
template: Place one pointer at the start and one at the end. Move the pointer that advances toward the solution based on the current values. For in-place problems, keep a slow writer pointer and a fast reader pointer.
common_mistakes: Moving both pointers when only one should move.
Using two pointers on unsorted data where a hash map is required.
